headline: Steelcast Limited files SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Steelcast Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Regulations, signalling a substantial acquisition event or takeover-related transaction; specific party details and consideration remain restricted pending full disclosure document review.
implication: Regulation 31(4) triggers when a substantial shareholder position is reached or an open offer is imminent—this filing serves as the mandatory gating disclosure, but the acquirer identity and offer price are typically reserved for the formal DPS/offer document that follows.
detail: The disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 is a mandatory filing when a party crosses the 25% threshold or makes an open offer. Steelcast's filing indicates a material corporate action is in motion. The NSE archive reference suggests the document was submitted to NSE in June 2026, but the substantive terms (acquirer, price, board recommendation) are typically housed in the separate DPS (Detailed Public Statement) or the offer letter itself.
